brief.headline: Ukrainian drones kill five in Rostov; Iranian ship hit in Caspian
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels led with deadly Ukrainian drone strikes across Russian regions—five killed in Rostov and casualties in Belgorod, Kerch, and LPR—while a claimed Ukrainian attack on an Iranian vessel in the Caspian dominated the geopolitical framing. Sentiment split sharply: grievance over strikes on Russia against upbeat claims of frontline gains and Putin's troop-strength increase.

developments.title: Ukrainian drone strikes kill five in Rostov, wound dozens
developments.body: Multiple channels reported a Ukrainian drone attack on Rostov-on-Don killing five (with reports of children among the dead) and thirteen wounded in Belgorod including two children; further strikes reported on Kerch (ten injured) and LPR (two killed). Casualty figures are channel-sourced and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Claimed Ukrainian strike on Iranian ship in Caspian Sea
developments.body: Channels amplified claims that Ukraine attacked an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea, killing a sailor, with Iran reportedly threatening retaliation—one channel citing a 'World War III' response. Framed as escalating regional tensions among Caspian states; claim is unconfirmed.

developments.title: Putin raises armed forces strength to 2.43 million
developments.body: Channels reported Putin authorized a 25,000-personnel increase to a total 2.426 million, effective August 1, framed positively; Sladkov separately claimed forces grew by 50,000 in two months. Flagged as mobilisation-related rhetoric across three channels.

developments.title: Claimed capture of Kommunarovka on Dnipropetrovsk direction
developments.body: Rybar, Poddubny and Kotsnews claimed Russian forces took Kommunarovka after weeks of fighting, alongside reported gains near Torske, Shevchenko, and Krasna Lyman. WarGonzo said forces approach the Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. All advances are channel-claimed and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Russian strikes on Ukrainian ports and shipping claimed
developments.body: Channels claimed strikes hit Odesa, Chornomorsk and Mykolaiv port infrastructure and fuel reserves, with cruise missiles reportedly sinking the Turkish cargo ship Golden Leo. Attacks framed as retaliation for Zelensky's declared '40-day peace-forcing operation'; claims unconfirmed.

developments.title: Romania expels Russian diplomat after F-16 downs drone
developments.body: Rybar reported Romania expelled a Russian diplomat following an F-16 shooting down a drone, with Russia denying involvement in the drone's origin. Framed as unwarranted Western escalation and part of NATO's growing maritime drone-defense integration on the Black Sea flank.

narrative_watch.title: 'Ukraine kills children' framing
narrative_watch.body: Channels paired reports of Belgorod/Rostov child casualties with a memorial day for 332 (or '500+') Donbas children killed since 2014, building a sustained victimhood-and-atrocity narrative to justify strikes on Ukraine.

narrative_watch.title: Caspian incident as regional-war trigger
narrative_watch.body: The claimed strike on an Iranian ship is being amplified to pull Iran and Caspian states into a broader anti-Ukraine framing, with 'World War III' rhetoric introduced.

narrative_watch.title: Western decline and depletion
narrative_watch.body: Rybar pushes claims of US arsenal depletion (31-38%) and rising European far-right (Austrian FPÖ at 38%), framing NATO as strained and internally fracturing.

mood_lines.text: Strongly negative (net -94); heavy grievance coverage of deadly drone strikes on Rostov, Belgorod, Kerch, LPR and the Caspian ship incident.
Uniformly positive (net +100); triumphant claims of port strikes, sunk cargo ships and destroyed fuel infrastructure framed as retaliation.
Positive (net +91); claimed advances at Kommunarovka, Torske and toward Slavyansk-Kramatorsk dominate, all unconfirmed.
Sharply up (net +69); troop-strength increase, migrant-control law, and defense-industry showcases drove an unusually upbeat domestic mood.
Negative (net -38); mixed coverage of Western aid, NATO maritime drone defenses, and Romania expulsion offset by claims of Western decline.
Sharply negative (net -100) but only two posts, both directed at Ukraine rather than Russian authorities.

flag_texts.title: Russia internal sentiment jumps +69
flag_texts.body: Domestic coverage turned sharply positive, driven by Putin's authorized 25,000-troop increase to 2.43 million, a new migrant-control law, and showcases of upgraded BMP-3s, combat robots and air-defense production.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation rumours across three channels
flag_texts.body: WarGonzo, Poddubny and Sladkov all posted on force expansion—a 25,000-personnel increase to 2.426 million effective August 1, plus Sladkov's claim of 50,000 added in two months—framed positively as voluntary growth.

flag_texts.title: No criticism of Putin
flag_texts.body: The watchlisted 'Criticism of Putin' theme was absent; the day's two criticism posts targeted Ukrainian figures, and Putin coverage was uniformly laudatory.
